verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same skyscraper reflow: the headline and copy stack well and the CTA is clear. In both, the VOLTSTRIDE box straddles the hard edge between the stripes and the green panel, which looks accidental, and the box is shrunk to a minor element. The headline and body text also run almost edge to edge with very thin side margins. B is slightly worse: its larger badge nearly touches the box, crowding the top, and its wider CTA pill sits closer to the canvas edges.
